shared_elements: carved relief on a tall vertical surface
single large anthropomorphic figure occupying most of the field
head with rendered eye near the upper part
incised linear/geometric detailing on the body area
justification: Both surfaces appear to present a single large relief figure in a tall vertical field, with a head bearing a marked eye set toward the top and linear detail below, which gives a loose compositional echo. But A shows a clearly readable profile figure with headgear, patterned garment, a held staff-like implement and a small subsidiary form at the feet, while B offers only a mass of ambiguous frontal-seeming shapes and blocky signs with none of those specific attributes or relationships legible.
